item.title: Bribery case filed against Rajitha Senaratne adjourned till Apr. 29
item.description: The Colombo High Court has ordered that the case filed by the Bribery Commission against former Minister of Fisheries Rajitha Senaratne and two others for allegedly causing a loss to the government when the Mutwal Fishery Harbour was leased to a private company in 2014—be reconvened on April 29. MORE..

item.title: India should consider age-based limits for social media access, economic adviser says
item.description: India s annual economic survey presented on Thursday recommended age-based limits to be considered for access to social media and gambling apps to counter what it called “digital addiction” in the country. MORE..

item.title: Hunger strike launched by Development Officers at Presidential Secretariat enters fourth day
item.description: The hunger strike launched by a group of Development Officers opposite the Presidential Secretariat— demanding that they be absorbed into the teacher service —continues today (29) for its fourth day. MORE..

item.title: Gold prices increase by Rs. 15,000 in Sri Lanka
item.description: The price of gold in Sri Lanka has risen following a surge in global gold prices. MORE..

item.title: Official allegedly misappropriates Aswesuma allowance; investigations launched
item.description: Investigations have been launched into an alleged fraud involving the payment of the Aswesuma allowance in the Kataragama Divisional Secretariat. MORE..

item.title: Starmer, Xi signal reset in China-UK ties, eye economic wins
item.description: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer told Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday that he wanted to build a “sophisticated relationship” with Beijing to boost the UK economy, signalling a reset after years of strained ties. MORE..

item.title: Public Finance Committee briefed on challenges facing gem and jewellery sector
item.description: The Committee on Public Finance (COPF) of Parliament has held extensive discussions on key issues affecting Sri Lanka s gem and jewellery industry. MORE..

item.title: Kalutara MC member granted bail over assault on motorcyclist during SJB protest
item.description: The Kalutara Magistrate s Court today (29) ordered the release on bail of Kalutara Municipal Council member Jayanath Navaratne, who was arrested in connection with an assault incident that occurred yesterday during a protest staged by a group of Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) activists in Kalutara town. MORE..

item.title: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva to visit Sri Lanka next month
item.description: The Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) Kristalina Georgieva is scheduled to visit Sri Lanka next month, according to a top IMF official. MORE..

item.title: Woman arrested with cocaine and ecstasy pills worth Rs. 220 million
item.description: A 48-year-old woman has been arrested in Ganemulla with 4.5 kilograms of cocaine and more than 3,400 ecstasy pills, with an estimated street value of around Rs. 220 million. MORE..
